title: apply_contract_context input
description: Input for `apply_contract_context`. Declares the contract context the analyzer cannot see into the federation's repos.yaml: endpoints a service exposes (`provides`) and which service a host expression dials (`host_aliases`). Dry-run by default; `snapshot` must be `live`.

service.description: A declared service, or an implicit repo-id service.

key.description: Endpoint key in the shared grammar, e.g. `http:POST /chat/stream`.

source.description: Where the declaration came from. Free-form.

host.description: The host expression as the analyzer records it (`HostPart::Expr`), e.g. `UPSTREAM_HTTP_ORIGIN`.

file.description: A repo-relative file. Every HTTP call in it whose host is unknown dials `service`.

service.description: A declared service, or an implicit repo-id service.

source.description: Where the mapping was established. Free-form.

dry_run.description: When true (the default), return the YAML that would be written and touch nothing.
